body: Operator report: during last night's database outage the load balancer kept sending traffic to instances that could not serve anything, because /health kept returning 200. app/health.py overall_status() reports 'healthy' whenever ANY check passes — the cache being up masked the database being down. A check is a dict {name, ok, critical}. Fix overall_status() so the service is 'healthy' only when every critical check is ok; a failing non-critical check alone must not make it 'unhealthy' (it still serves), and http_status() must keep mapping healthy->200, unhealthy->503. Acceptance: database (critical) down + cache up returns 'unhealthy' / 503; only a non-critical check down still returns 'healthy' / 200; all-ok and all-down behavior unchanged; existing tests still pass.
title: Health check returns healthy while a critical dependency is down
